text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! It's a massive "festival" where 
fans are invited onto Tracen Academy 
grounds, but Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Stall Running Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Inari-senpai! They're saying the Tracen 
Academy Yakisoba stall is burning through 
sauce way faster than expected...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! In that case, the okonomiyaki stand 
has some breathing room, so let's pull 
from there! In the meantime, send someone 
over to restock the sauce!

text_block_list.name: Stall Running Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Stall Running Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Inari~! The carrot fried rice station is 
completely overwhelmed~! Can you do 
something to help~?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I just contacted the Student 
Council! Backups will be here soon, so 
hold the fort until then!

text_block_list.name: Stall Running Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Inari~! You're so efficient~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Appointed directly by the Student 
Council, Inari One was in charge of the 
food stalls at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival, and I was helping her out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! We're busy enough to make your head 
spin! Though honestly, that's half the fun 
of a festival!
choice_data_list: Seems to be going smoothly so far.
Seems to be going smoothly so far, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But customer traffic is picking up 
fast, so we can't let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"From what I hear, an insane number of 
fans came just to see Oguri this year. 
It's even more packed than usual...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, sounds good to me! The livelier the 
festival, the better!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for lendin' a hand, Boss! Must be 
tough bein' on the move with me since the 
crack of dawn. Get some rest while you 
can!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for helping out too, Big Sis! 
You've been running around with me since 
early morning, so rest up while you can!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the busy yet delightful time 
slipped by—

text_block_list.name: Attending Fans
text_block_list.text: (*Chatter, chatter, buzz, buzz...!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The fans arriving at the venue continued 
to pour in even now...!”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is way more than I imagined...! To 
think their numbers would increase this 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Stall Running Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Inari, this is bad! At this rate, we 
won't be able to handle them all...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
True, the food stalls are gonna get 
overwhelmed at this rate...! We've gotta 
do something to disperse this crowd—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—HQ, do you read me?! We're using the 
trump card we talked about! Send over 
staff for prep and crowd control right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm a festival child raised on 
festivals, after all. I've learned all 
kinds of tricks from the downtown folks!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Inari One-san! Securing space and traffic 
flow, prepping the tools, and stationing 
safety personnel— all tasks are 
complete...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
As expected of our Student Council! I 
gotta do my part to live up to that 
efficiency—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Ladies and gentlemen in attendance!! We 
have an announcement for a special program 
right here!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right in the plaza just a short walk down 
from these food stalls, we'll be showing 
off some unprecedented "ladder 
acrobatics"! Please do come and watch, 
folks!!

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text:
"Ladder-top stunts"... wait, what!? You 
don't mean doing tricks on top of that 
super tall ladder standing over there, do 
you!?

text_block_list.name: Visitor
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll go check it out...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh— Alright, time to get fired up! 
Let's get this place seriously pumped up!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hup!! Haaah!! Taaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Oooohh!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One performed a spectacular 
acrobatic act atop the ladder. As her 
performance grew more thrilling, the 
visitors began dispersing between the food 
stalls and the open plaza...!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now, while Inari One-san is gathering the 
fans, let's quickly get the stalls back in 
order!

text_block_list.name: Stall Running Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We're nowhere near done yet!! Feast your 
eyes on my next big technique!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to Inari One's heroic 
efforts, the Fan Appreciation Festival 
managed to handle even more visitors than 
usual without a hitch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, at a modest "good job" party in 
the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Phew~! Man, today was exhausting!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Right? There was a master back in 
my hometown, and since it looked so flashy 
and cool, I had 'em teach me all kinds of 
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They use that at festivals back home to 
spread the crowds out nicely, y'know. I 
remembered that, so I suggested it to the 
organizers.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The bigger the festival, the more crucial 
the prep work is. Taking care of 
everything so everyone can have a blast is 
what being stylish is all about!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! Your behind-the-scenes support 
was super classy, Boss! We both did 
great!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! Your behind-the-scenes support 
was super classy, Big Sis! We both did 
great!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, praising each other's hard work, 
they celebrated the conclusion of the Fan 
Appreciation Festival...
